Best social media posting service for real estate agents: posting service, scheduler or agency?

Short answer

Real estate agents have three ways to keep social media going: a scheduling tool, a full social media agency, or a done for you posting service. A scheduler publishes posts you still write and design. An agency runs your accounts with strategy, ads and replies, usually on a contract. A posting service makes the posts for you every week on your brand. LocalLift Signature, from The SocialDM, is a posting service: 3 local posts a week for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Google Business, with your headshot, logo, brokerage and contact details on every one, for $199 a month, month to month.

The SocialDM · Nov 27, 2026
The problem

Posting service vs scheduler vs agency

01Scheduling tool. You write the captions and design every post, then the tool publishes on time. Best if you like making content and only need it organized.
02Full social media agency. A team runs strategy, posting, often ads and comment replies. Best if you want a hands off account manager and have the budget for a contract.
03Done for you posting service. Posts are made for you every week on your brand and sized for each platform. Best if you want a steady local feed without making it yourself.
04What to compare. Who writes and designs the posts, how local and dated they are, whether your brokerage is on every post, how many platforms are covered, and whether there is a contract.
05Where LocalLift Signature fits. A posting service: 3 local posts a week, your brand and brokerage on each, month to month.
How to choose in one minuteIf you enjoy making posts, a scheduler is enough. If you want someone to run everything including ads, look at an agency. If you want the posting done every week without a contract, use a posting service and keep adding your own listings and stories.
Brokerage on every postArizona advertising rules expect your brokerage on your ads, so LocalLift Signature puts it on every post by default.
FAQ

Questions we hear

What is the best social media posting service for real estate agents?

The best fit is one that makes the posts for you every week, keeps them local and dated, puts your brand and brokerage on each one and has no contract. LocalLift Signature does that for $199 a month: 3 posts a week for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Google Business.

Is a posting service the same as a scheduling tool?

No. A scheduling tool only publishes posts you make yourself. A posting service writes and designs the posts for you.

Is a posting service the same as a social media agency?

No. An agency usually manages strategy, ads and replies on a contract. A posting service focuses on making and delivering your weekly posts.

Do I need to approve every post?

No. You approve your brand details once at sign up, and the posts come every week after that.

Is there a contract?

No. LocalLift Signature is month to month and you can cancel anytime.
